Forward jumps expire or reclassify entries deterministically without duplicate episode transitions.
Recovery, source supersession, and asset removal close the exact suppression episode immediately with a typed bounded reason rather than waiting for another alert attempt or poller shutdown.
Removing and re-adding the same asset or source starts a new episode identity and count, and independent keys remain independent.

Missing, corrupt, unreadable, and future-skewed throttle state uses the vocabulary coordinated with issues #2447, #2533, and #2534 without absorbing their separately owned availability or reset contracts.

issues.falsifier_or_remaining_gap: The issue would be falsified by one bounded, externally consumable poller snapshot that distinguishes starting, current, partial, late, stalled, failed, and stopped; advances generation and sequence; records monotonic duration and lag; counts scheduled, completed, skipped, and failed work; declares expected, observed, and unavailable sources; preserves last-good comparison state; and requires a fresh fully observed post-restart cycle before recovery. This lane did not add the audit-only failing tests needed to inject a never-resolving cycle, partial source failures, clock movement, stop during flight, or restart generation because mutation was restricted to this review record. The 48 passing tests therefore prove stable existing behavior, not cycle freshness or coverage. No production runtime probe was attempted, so observed operational incidence and alert thresholds remain measurement obligations rather than verified outage claims.
issues.impact: A live timer and quiet log can look healthy while realtime invalidation cycles are skipped, stalled, partially observed, or repeatedly failing. Operators and downstream clients cannot distinguish a current producer from stale last-good state, cannot measure how much fleet coverage is missing, and cannot prove recovery after restart. That can leave browser caches and aggregate fleet status stale while transport reachability still appears green.
